decision: Use the existing Universal Plugin Socket for AVF capability probing; do not put native probing logic in Stabilize core and do not create a second orchestrator.

existing_socket_behavior.registry: Indexes PluginSpec by name/capability and guarantees at most one workflow_owner.
existing_socket_behavior.loader: Mounts only pre-registered explicit factories; arbitrary import strings are forbidden.
existing_socket_behavior.mount_guard: Rejects disabled plugins, donor/test production mount, missing code_root/factory_key and any workflow owner other than stabilize_core.
existing_socket_behavior.activation: Only names in _APPROVED_FACTORY_KEYS may become enabled and receive a factory_key.
existing_socket_behavior.catalog: Canonical tuple of PluginSpec entries; all are disabled by default.
existing_socket_behavior.adapter_pattern: Existing adapters package dependencies.py + factory.py + runtime.py + __init__.py. factory.py exposes a stable FACTORY_KEY and build_*_factories mapping; runtime.py owns normalized runtime state/health; dependencies.py allows explicit injected dependencies; __init__.py exports the public adapter surface.

exact_minimal_runtime_delta_if_authorize.responsibility: Explicit injectable Android/host probe dependencies for deterministic tests; no dynamic arbitrary import contract.
Immutable normalized capability result and health/gate semantics from AVF-CAPABILITY-PROBE-CONTRACT; no acquisition/provider mutation.
Resolve only approved platform bridge/injected dependency, build runtime and expose build_android_avf_factories(). Fail closed if bridge unavailable or evidence invalid.
Export FACTORY_KEY, dependencies/runtime types and explicit factory builders.

reason_not_to_change: Current code already supplies capability indexing, explicit-factory loading, disabled-by-default fail-closed mount and single workflow-owner enforcement. Existing adapter packages already prove the factory layout. Duplicating these mechanisms would be overengineering and collision risk.
tests_required_before_enable: API<34 or feature absent -> fail-closed capability result
guest boot NOT_RUN never becomes PASS
fallback selection never becomes AVF PASS
plugin remains enabled=False until factory and real test evidence exist
integration finalization rejects AVF COMPLETE without guest boot evidence

ownership.runtime_mutation: coordinator or explicitly assigned code owner
ownership.workflow_owner: Stabilize CORE remains the only workflow owner

next_action: Coordinator may authorize runtime mutation using these exact insertion points and reference adapter pattern. Until then S2 continues debate/read-only verification.
